# MiddleClass.SG

> > A Singapore lifestyle website for the middle class, focusing on Korea, K-content, Asia travel, food, and budget-friendly living.

MiddleClass.SG is a digital lifestyle platform catering to Singapore's middle-class audience with content about Korean culture, travel destinations across Asia, food experiences, and practical budget lifestyle tips. The site has been recognized by The Korean Embassy and The Embassy of the Republic of Korea to Singapore for excellence in K-content.

## Key Topics

- Singapore lifestyle
- Korea and K-content
- Asia travel
- Budget-friendly living
- Food and dining
- Korean culture
- South Korea
- Singapore Best K-Content Awards
- Content marketing
- Brand collaborations
- Social media presence (TikTok, Instagram, Facebook)
- Video production
- Middle-class audience
